cohort: Young women (median age 34, range 25-40) with newly diagnosed invasive breast cancer during pregnancy, identified from the Young Women's Breast Cancer Study.
finding: Pregnancy at diagnosis is relatively uncommon in young women with breast cancer, and treatment during pregnancy can generally be consistent with standard surgical and chemotherapy approaches, with attention to timing of therapies.
followup_time: 6 months after delivery (for comprehensive staging in some patients)
gest_age: 41% of live births were before 37 weeks of gestation.
